questions.text: My leader effectively communicates important information to the team.
My leader is approachable and willing to listen to concerns.
I feel supported by my leader in achieving my goals.
He/She provides clear expectations for performance.
He/She encourages open and honest feedback.
My leader makes decisions based on the team's input and needs.
He/She  is decisive and takes action when necessary.
He/She addresses challenges in a timely and effective manner.
He/She fosters a solution-oriented approach within the team.
His/Her decisions align with the company's goals and values.
My leader inspires and motivates me to do my best work.
He/She provides opportunities for personal and professional growth.
He/She recognizes and celebrates team achievements.
He/She empowers team members to take ownership of their work.
He/She encourages creativity and innovation within the team.
My leader acts with honesty and integrity in all situations.
He/She takes responsibility for their decisions and actions.
He/She treats all team members fairly and without bias.
He/She follows through on commitments and promises.
I trust my leader to act in the best interest of the team.
